namespace = eu5ab_monthly

eu5ab_monthly.1 = {
	type = country_event
	title = eu5ab_window_title
	outcome = neutral
	hidden = yes

	immediate = {
 eu5ab_manual_expire = yes
 if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_manual_month_current = yes } }
		# Vanilla building allow/potential checks resolve the constructing country
		# through scope:actor. Each delayed country event must recreate that scope.
		save_scope_as = actor
		eu5ab_expire_old_scan_month = yes
		if = {
			limit = { eu5ab_scan_calendar_open = yes NOT = { eu5ab_scan_month_current = yes } is_human = yes var:eu5ab_global_enabled > 0 NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_round_active } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active } }
			eu5ab_reset_policy_budgets_if_needed = yes
			eu5ab_run_regional_development_policy = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active eu5ab_scan_month_current = yes eu5ab_scan_calendar_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load }
				OR = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_dispatch_day } NOT = { var:eu5ab_scan_dispatch_day = eu5ab_pl_today } } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_dispatch_day value = eu5ab_pl_today }
			eu5ab_finish_pending_capacity_workers = yes
			eu5ab_merge_location_worker_results = yes
			if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_scan_bucket_day <= 20 } eu5ab_scan_regional_development_bucket = yes }
			else = { eu5ab_scan_initial_tail = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { var:eu5ab_scan_bucket_day < 21 }
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_day add = 1 }
				trigger_event_silently = { id = eu5ab_monthly.1 days = 1 }
			}
			else = { set_variable = eu5ab_scan_finalizing trigger_event_silently = { id = eu5ab_monthly.2 days = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } }
			set_variable = eu5ab_scan_finalizing trigger_event_silently = { id = eu5ab_monthly.2 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}
}

eu5ab_monthly.2 = {
	type = country_event
	title = eu5ab_window_title
	outcome = neutral
	hidden = yes

	immediate = {
 eu5ab_manual_expire = yes
 if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_manual_month_current = yes } }
		# Keep the constructing country available while finalizing and dispatching the queue.
		save_scope_as = actor
		eu5ab_expire_old_scan_month = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } }
			eu5ab_finish_pending_capacity_workers = yes
			eu5ab_merge_location_worker_results = yes
			eu5ab_finish_regional_development_scan = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			# Old saves can already have a finalizer scheduled for the 22nd.
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active eu5ab_scan_month_current = yes eu5ab_scan_calendar_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } }
			if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_dispatch_day } NOT = { var:eu5ab_scan_dispatch_day = eu5ab_pl_today } } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_dispatch_day value = eu5ab_pl_today }
				eu5ab_finish_pending_capacity_workers = yes
				eu5ab_merge_location_worker_results = yes
				eu5ab_scan_initial_tail = yes
			}
			trigger_event_silently = { id = eu5ab_monthly.2 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}
}

# Continue persisted work after scheduled pre-load events have drained.
eu5ab_monthly.4 = {
    type = country_event
    title = eu5ab_window_title
    outcome = neutral
    hidden = yes
    immediate = {
        save_scope_as = actor
        eu5ab_expire_old_scan_month = yes
        if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load }
            remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load
            if = { limit = { is_human = yes var:eu5ab_global_enabled > 0 }
                if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active } eu5ab_resume_saved_queue = yes }
                else_if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_refill_active }
                    trigger_event_silently = { id = eu5ab_monthly.3 days = 1 }
                }
                else_if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active }
                    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_finalizing }
                        trigger_event_silently = { id = eu5ab_monthly.2 days = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { trigger_event_silently = { id = eu5ab_monthly.1 days = 1 } }
                }
                else_if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_round_active } eu5ab_settle_scan_candidate_batch = yes }
                else_if = { limit = { any_owned_location = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id } }
                    trigger_event_silently = { id = eu5ab_monthly.1 days = 1 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}


eu5ab_monthly.3 = {
    type = country_event
    title = eu5ab_window_title
    outcome = neutral
    hidden = yes
    immediate = {
 eu5ab_manual_expire = yes
 if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_manual_month_current = yes } }
        save_scope_as = actor
        eu5ab_expire_old_scan_month = yes
        if = {
            limit = { eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes has_variable = eu5ab_scan_refill_active NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load }
                OR = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_dispatch_day } NOT = { var:eu5ab_scan_dispatch_day = eu5ab_pl_today } } }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_dispatch_day value = eu5ab_pl_today }
            eu5ab_finish_pending_capacity_workers = yes
            eu5ab_merge_location_worker_results = yes
            if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_global_enabled > 0 } eu5ab_check_scan_refill_progress = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_refill_active } }
                # Recovery has closed this month's exhausted/stalled work.
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { NOT = { var:eu5ab_global_enabled > 0 } }
                eu5ab_clear_engine_candidate_queue = yes
                eu5ab_reset_committed_construction_demand = yes
                remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_active
                eu5ab_complete_scan_round = yes
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = {
                    eu5ab_scan_attempt_count < { value = var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget }
                    has_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_unscanned_locations
                    OR = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active } eu5ab_scan_early_stop_value <= 0 eu5ab_scan_reserve_count < { value = var:eu5ab_scan_candidate_target } }
                }
                eu5ab_refill_regional_development_scan = yes
                trigger_event_silently = { id = eu5ab_monthly.3 days = 1 }
            }
            else = {
                remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_refill_active
                if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active } eu5ab_finish_regional_development_scan = yes }
                else = { eu5ab_complete_scan_round = yes eu5ab_reset_committed_construction_demand = yes }
            }
        }
    }
}
}

namespace = eu5ab_queue_watchdog

eu5ab_queue_watchdog.1 = {
	type = country_event
	title = eu5ab_window_title
	outcome = neutral
	hidden = yes

	immediate = {
		eu5ab_expire_old_scan_month = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } }
			eu5ab_check_engine_candidate_queue_watchdog = yes
			# A successful check may finish the queue. Only an active queue needs
			# another independent liveness check.
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } }
				trigger_event_silently = { id = eu5ab_queue_watchdog.1 days = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
}

namespace = eu5ab_worker

eu5ab_worker.1 = {
	type = location_event
	title = eu5ab_window_title
	outcome = neutral
	hidden = yes

	immediate = {
		# Recreate actor for vanilla building allow/potential checks. All mutations
		# below remain on this location until the country reducer runs next day.
		owner = { save_scope_as = actor }
		# An event from an earlier scan must not consume a fresh request that
		# is still waiting for its GUI snapshot. The daily fallback handles it.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_capacity_requested } }
			eu5ab_run_capacity_worker_once = yes
		}
	}
}
